sn34.2:1.4: Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo || || 5
sn34.2:1.5: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo || || 6
sn34.2:1.6: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyi neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo || || 7
sn34.2:1.7: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca || || 8
sn34.2:1.8: Tatra kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca || ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnam aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca || || 9
sn34.2:1.9: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggam akkhāyati ||
sn34.2:1.10: evam eva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca || pe || pavaro cāti || || 1-3
